scenes.headline: Christmas gifts kids can make themselves 🎁
scenes.text: Need a Christmas gift your kids can actually make themselves? Here are four that grandparents love.

scenes.title: Salt Dough Ornaments
scenes.text: Mix flour, salt and water, cut out stars, bake, then paint.

scenes.title: Fingerprint Light Mugs
scenes.text: Draw a loopy string, then press painted fingertips along it as the bulbs.

scenes.title: Hot Cocoa Jar
scenes.text: Layer cocoa, sugar, chocolate chips and mini marshmallows, then add a tag.

scenes.title: Pom-Pom Gnomes
scenes.text: A pom-pom beard, a bead nose, and a little felt hat.

scenes.subtitle: Gift craft cards + gift tags
scenes.text: Free printable gift craft cards for all 15 gifts, plus cut-out gift tags.
